newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi stocks up as see-saw trend continues.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi stocks up as see-saw trend continues.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index rose on Friday as a recent see-saw trend on the bourse continued, brokers and bourse officials said.
The index rose 13.70 points to stand at 3072.76. Turnover was posted at 5,199 million shillings on 155,626 from 20.314 million shillings on 661,345 shares on Thursday.

"The market's activity was low as trading was based on the general floor. There was no major movement today compared to Thursday where Firestone East Africa had dealt one huge lot on the special board, an official said.
A senior broker said that with the few company announcements made during the week, the market saw a lot of activity but prices did not change drastically.
Financials continued to be the most active sector.
Barclays Bank rose a shilling to 104, Diamond Trust gained to 38 from 37 and Kenya Commercial Bank rose to 52.50 from 50 on 3,880 shares.
National career Kenya Airways was steady at 10.10, Marshalls East Africa rose a shilling to 47 and Nation Printers & Publishers gained to 107 from 106.
Brokers said there was a lot of demand for Nation Printers & Publishers but the supply was low while Kenya Airways was holding steady with only one buyer for the stock.
Officials said foreign investors dealt 5,500 shares of Sasini Tea & Coffee at 53. Kakuzi rose to 96 from 95.50. Rea Vipingo was steady at 10.90 on 11,000 shares.
